basic_info.description: Rare two-level penthouse with a private terrace, two-car parking, and private storage room. This 2BD/2.5BA residence features soaring floor-to-ceiling windows, hardwood flooring throughout the main living and dining areas, and designer-appointed bathrooms. The sleek kitchen is outfitted with Studio Becker custom cabinetry, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, gas cooktop, and Cambria stone countertops. The upper level is dedicated to both bedrooms and includes its own private entrance on the 9th floor offering added convenience and privacy. Located directly across from the new 4th & Brannan subway station for quick city access. Just steps to Whole Foods, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and some of the city's best restaurants and bars. Full-service luxury building includes 24-hour concierge and security, fitness center, business and conference rooms, resident lounge, and a 20-seat private theater.
